HFT visibility is governed by the authoring policy above.","docket_mode":"quarantine_without_hft","docket_ready":true}},"selected_context_units":[],"support_registry":[{"branch_refs":["root_001273/B001","root_001273/B013"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:3","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_0e18c33aedd0c4cad1bb","text":"3. **A people addressed as capable of rising to a task (exploratory).** The surface قوم is directly covered by **ق و م B001**, while **ق و م B003** supplies rising with resolve to undertake a matter. Later, bodies fall in prostration (32:15), sides rise from beds (32:16), and all stand at the Resurrection (**ق و م B013**, 32:25). I infer that naming the audience قوم faintly activates their capacity to stand into response. The group is not only an ethnic or social aggregate; it is a body being called to take up guidance.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_001488/B001","root_001583/B001"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:3","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_2549d8b348faa3f8304b","text":"3. **Warning opens a path rather than merely announcing danger.** `ن ذ ر:B001` is warning that awakens fear and caution; `ه د ي:B001` is gentle indication toward a way or truth. Their grammatical linkage through two purpose particles makes caution the warning’s assigned role and guidance its possible result. **Inferred arrow:** newly supplied warning -> awakened caution -> capacity to take direction. The absence of an earlier warner becomes a missing causal stage, and this ayah presents the present warning as supplying it.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000347/B001","root_001150/B003"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_5d44f28f8f87fab456f8","text":"1. **Fabrication versus tightly established truth.** **ف ر ي B003** supplies fabricated falsehood, but **ف ر ي B001-B002** retain the underlying images of cutting to make and cutting destructively. Against these, **ح ق ق B001** gives established truth and **ح ق ق B010** gives tight-made firmness. The accusation and rebuttal are placed as opposed constructions. I infer that the disputed issue is whether the discourse has been arbitrarily cut and assembled or is firmly fitted to reality. الحق therefore reads as structural integrity, not only correct content.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000347/B001","root_000347/B005","root_000347/B010","root_001150/B001","root_001150/B002","root_001150/B003"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-1","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_6934f30c7708f4f3f092","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"32:3:3\",\"root_001150\",[\"B001\",\"B002\",\"B003\"]],[\"32:3:6\",\"root_000347\",[\"B001\",\"B005\",\"B010\"]]],\"grade\":\"strong\",\"text\":\"Uydurma suçlamasındaki kesip birleştirme imgesi ile gerçeğin sıkıca kurulmuş yapısı karşı karşıya gelir; tartışma yalnız doğruluk değil, sözün gerçekliğe nasıl oturduğu üzerindedir.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_001150/B003"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_70886d759c8d835d5d20","text":"1. **The fabrication charge is a rival account of composition.** `ف ر ي:B003` directly supplies fabricating a lie, while `ف ر ي:B001` supplies cutting material in order to stitch or craft it. Around the allegation, 32:2 names a composed book and 32:4–8 repeatedly depict measured creation, formation, and extraction. The latent craft image gives the accusers’ implied mechanism: pieces were humanly cut and joined into a made discourse. **Inferred arrow (the accusers’):** observable verbal composition -> human patchwork -> false attribution. The *bal* reversal rejects not composition itself but their assignment of its maker; *iftarāhu* becomes a competing causal story about how the book was formed.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_001488/B001","root_001583/B001","root_001583/B002"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-2","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_7a1af7473256eb8ce074","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"32:3:9\",\"root_001488\",[\"B001\"]],[\"32:3:14\",\"root_001488\",[\"B001\"]],[\"32:3:18\",\"root_001583\",[\"B001\",\"B002\"]]],\"grade\":\"strong\",\"text\":\"Uyarı, korku ve dikkati uyandırarak yön değişikliğine imkân veren bir yol düzeltme müdahalesi olarak işler.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_001488/B001"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:retrospective_surprises_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_7de951e2829c2ff93b79","text":"Later 32:4-6 made the warning pathway more than a local speech event.
